title: Software platform NYC HOPWS eCOMPAS
agency_path: City of New York > Health and Mental Hygiene
description_text: RDE System Support Group, LLC  will provide DOHMH with RDEs proprietary web software platform, NYC HOPWA eCOMPAS (electronic Comprehensive Outcomes Measurement Program for Accountability and Success), which will be utilized by DOHMHs HOPWA and Ryan White Part A housing programs to manage its client level data, housing inventory, provider contracts, fiscal processes and required reporting to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), and to the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA).
